name: 同時に一つ選ぶセグメント切替
prompt:
Use case: direct image edit for LH07-0025 v008. Owner feedback says the current compact candidate is still too compact; the exact original is too large and spacious.

Image 1 is the exact original and controls the labels, shape, typography, state and green. Image 2 is registered v007; it is still too narrow. Produce a clearly more open middle version: in the 2172×724 composition, make the segmented control about 82% of canvas width and 31% of canvas height, centered at x≈195–1977 and y≈250–474. This must be visibly wider than Image 2, with about 11% more width. Keep the original label size unchanged, so the wider control adds comfortable horizontal breathing room. Restore a little vertical space compared with the compact candidate while staying slightly shorter than the original.

Preserve the exact labels 「小さめ」「標準」「大きめ」, three equal cells, center-selected 「標準」 state, Japanese Meiryo-style typography, white canvas, subtle light-gray border and shadow, dividers, rounded ends, forest-green center fill with white selected text, and slate-gray unselected labels. Do not alter wording, state, palette, label size or image aspect ratio. Add no icons, controls or decoration. Do not make the control as narrow as Image 2.
reviewNotes: Visual candidate reviewed: noticeably more open than v006/v007 and still smaller than v001; exact labels/state preserved. Candidate-level review only, not owner approval.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.observation: Original 354x44 component; too large/spacious but authoritative for labels, typography, selected state and colors.
v007 was recorded needs-correction; actual control remained similar to v006 and too narrow.
